In `scripts/player.gd`, `take_damage` now calls a new `_flash()` that tweens the Sprite2D's `modulate` to red and back to white, 0.1s each way (0.2s total). I didn't run it, since Godot isn't installed.

The existing `flash_color` export now defaults to red instead of white, so the tween uses it as the flash color. A new hit kills any flash still running before starting another.
